description.value:
You house the dead who finished — the ones who lived out a full life before the world ended it for everyone else. Grandparents, elders, the last honest foremen. Patient. Slow to anger. Extremely difficult to rush.

  • The Long View: in Quiet, once per scene you can ask a Long-Shadow spirit what it would have done, and act on unusually good advice.
  • Steadying Hand: Unveiled, you can lend a measure of the spirit's composure to an ally instead of yourself — this Covenant is the only one built to spend its Parleys on other people as often as itself.
  • Toll accrues slowest of all and forgives fastest during downtime — but a Long-Shadow spirit will simply refuse an ask it finds beneath it, Toll or no Toll. No amount of pushing changes a dead grandmother's mind.
